title: Finite local coefficient models for restricted scalar-extension cohomology
statement:
Let $a:X\to T$ be a morphism of schemes and let $f:A\to B$ be a unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings. Work on their small pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with constant ring sheaves $A_T,B_T,A_X,B_X$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and the exact constant-coefficient inverse images $a_A^*,a_B^*$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Use the ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], their cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves], and K-flat derived extension $K_B=K\otimes_{A_T}^{\mathbf L}B_T$ with its right-factor $B_T$-action [def-weil-pbc-constant-coefficient-scalar-extension, def-weil-derived-tensor]. Let $K\in D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},A)$ be bounded above. Suppose every $a_A^*\mathcal H^j(K)$ is locally constant and has finite geometric stalks [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk]. Then, for every $q\in\mathbf Z$, there is a pro-étale covering $\{V_{q,t}\to X\}_t$ and finite $B$-modules $M_{q,t}$ such that
$$\left(a_B^*\mathcal H^q(K_B)\right)|_{V_{q,t}}\simeq\underline{M_{q,t}}_{V_{q,t}}$$
as $B_X|_{V_{q,t}}$-module sheaves, using constant module sheaves on localized sites [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf, def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. The covers may depend on $q$. No lower cohomological bound, constructible stratification, finite Tor amplitude, flatness of $B$ over $A$, or invertibility of a prime on $T$ is assumed.

proof.text: Choose a cochain representative G of K and a K-flat quasi-isomorphism P→G. The localization gives Q(P)≅K. Its cohomology gives isomorphisms H^j(P)≅H^j(K) independently of the chosen localization universe. Use P itself as the first complex and its own K-flat resolution.

Set L=Res(B_T)[0]. The coefficient-complex lemma gives locally constant pulled-back cohomology with finite stalks. Single-complex homology gives the upper bound zero. Transport the input hypotheses and bound from K to P. Exact coefficient pullback gives the required termwise bounds.

Apply the existing restricted tensor finite-local-constancy theorem to P,L and the identity resolution of P. Its conclusion is local constancy and finite stalks for the A-module pullback of each tensor cohomology sheaf.

The proved K-flat scalar/tensor cohomology comparison identifies its underlying set sheaf with the B-module pullback of scalar-extension cohomology. Compose with the image of Q(P)≅K under the chosen derived extension, cohomology and pullback functors.
The finite-underlying-model lemma converts tensor cohomology local constancy and finite stalks into objectwise finite constant set models. Transport each model through the preceding isomorphism.

Apply the finite-action/localized-model bridge to the actual B-module sheaf. This produces finite B-module models of precisely the required localized construction. The argument is for arbitrary fixed q, with no uniform cover or lower bound.
